description: This Python source file defines a Content Filter Guardrail class for LiteLLM, implementing regex pattern matching and keyword filtering to detect and block/mask sensitive content. It includes configuration loading, pattern compilation, keyword detection, blocking/masking actions, and integration with streaming responses.
